about.seoDescription: Raluca Andrenacci: certified coach and practitioner mentor with over 20 years of entrepreneurial experience, based in Milan.
about.title: Raluca Andrenacci
about.lead: Certified coach and practitioner mentor, currently based in Milan.
bio: With over 20 years of entrepreneurial experience, including in media and advertising, real estate and construction development, and HoReCa, Raluca has a wealth of expertise to offer her clients.

She offers customized one-on-one and remote mentoring programs to individuals who want to improve their performance, leverage their skills and reach their full potential. Her clients appreciate her practical expertise, her focus on strategy, motivation and action, and her ability to provide clarity, knowledge, guidance and new perspectives.

Whether you are an entrepreneur looking for direction, a leader seeking more fulfilment, or a visionary in need of rediscovery, Raluca invites you to challenge yourself by joining her on the journey towards success.
